text: The new bank details from that email went onto the supplier file, so the run paid the account it named, not Harlow. We spotted it afterwards and asked the bank to recall the payment, but the money was gone that same afternoon. That was just over six thousand four hundred pounds, in an account the attacker controls.
style: Brightwell's finance manager, in her 40s, who came up through accounts payable, warm and direct. Speak with a consistent British accent with a light Nigerian inflection throughout — do not shift to any other accent.
